On the device

What to press on the Tracker. B1 to B8 are the eight buttons under the screen.

Recording
B1 or RecRecord. A one-bar count-in, then the first take records the bars you set (4 at 80 BPM to start) and stops on the bar line. On a track that has a Part, Rec layers a new pass over it (Config can switch to Replace).
B2 TempoBefore the first take: starting tempo. Once there is a loop, B2 is Stop.
B3 or PlayPlay the loop
B4Monitor the input on or off
B5 to B8Select Track 1 to 4. Press the selected one again to open it large.
Shift + StopUndo the last take (brings back the previous layer)
Shift + JogWhile a layer is armed or recording: Fade, how much of the older audio stays
Setting the BPM (B2 Tempo)
B1 FreeNo set tempo: the first take sets the loop and the tempo is worked out from its length
B2 SetTakes land on a grid at the tempo you choose
JogChange the BPM by 0.1 (Shift: by 1), 40 to 240
Left, RightChoose Tempo, Count-in, Wait for sound or Bars; Jog changes it, Insert switches it. Bars: only lengths that fit 16 s.
B7 OK, B8B7 keeps it, B8 cancels
Shift + PlayClick (metronome) on or off. A CLICK tag shows in the top bar.
Shift on the home screen
Shift + B1Loop mode: Repeat or Play once
Shift + B2Pads (what the pads do)
Shift + B3Memory (recording time left)
Shift + B4Input: choose a track's source (Line, mics, Pads)
Shift + B5 to B8Mute Track 1 to 4
Shift + Up, DownLevel of the selected track (1 dB a press)
Shift + Left, RightLevel of the synth (chord pads), 1 dB a press
JogScrub the position, stopped or playing (a sixteenth a click; Shift: a bar)
Left, RightMove the playhead one beat
Up, DownChoose the track
Shift + StopUndo the last take
PatternWith the chord pads on: the Play view, and back
File, B7Settings (project: click, grid, snap, count-in). The output volume is in Config.
InsertActions for the selected Part (move, edit, glitch, mute, undo)
Shift + InsertMove the Part (Jog steps by the grid, Shift by 1 ms)
Buttons beside the screen
ParamsTrack mixer: level, pan, tone, mute, solo
PerformGlitch effects for the selected track
Sample EditPart Editor: trim, fades, offset, grid
MasterLo-fi master (tape saturation, glue, wow). It starts off: switch it on here.
FileProjects: save, load, export WAV
ConfigDevice settings, firmware update
Sample LoadLoad WAV files from the SD card onto the pads
Sample PlaySettings of the pad sample (tune, volume, start, end)
Sample RecResample the mix into a pad slot
CopyCopy the selected Part to another track. Shift + Copy undoes a copy or clear.
DeleteClear the selected Part. Shift + Delete: all tracks, or Reset all.
PatternBack to the home screen from anywhere
Chords and sound
NoteChords page. The pads play chords and scale notes. With them on, Rec records them (the track's source becomes Pads).
Chords pageLeft, Right: choose Key, Scale, Style, Sound, Voicing or Octave; Jog changes it. B1 pads on or off, B2 Sets (8 saved chord sets), B3 Reset, B4 Sound, B7 Play view, B8 back.
Left hand (columns 1 to 8)Row 1 seventh chords I to vii, row 2 triads, rows 3 and 4 the scale notes (two octaves). Colours: Home, Away, Tension.
Right hand (columns 9 to 12)Row 1 sus2 sus4 6 7, row 2 maj7 add9 9 flip: hold while you press a chord (double-tap to latch). Rows 3 and 4: Block, Strum dn, Strum up, Arp up, Arp dn, Oct -, Oct +, Hold. Shift + Jog: arp rate or strum speed.
Rec on an empty trackAsks what to record: B1 Chords, B2 Bass, B3 Melody, B4 Drums, B5 Audio. Then choose the sound (jog), B8 arms. Shift + Rec skips both. Bass and Melody: scale notes on the left, helpers on the right. Drums: kits and note repeat on the left, the drum voices on the right. Pattern shows the pad map.
FX1Reverb and delay: B1 and B2 switch them on, Left and Right choose the block, Up and Down the setting or a track's send, jog changes it
FX2Live filter: hold B1, or latch with B2; jog sweeps; B4 to B7 choose LP-HP, LP, HP or Band; B3 resets
InstrSound page: pick a patch, tweak the eight knobs, hold B1 to hear it, B7 for every setting
